changes.title: AWS Health now supports resource and account tags
changes.detail: AWS Health now supports resource and account tags in Health events. This new capability enables you to enrich Health events with resource tags and account tags, providing additional context to help you manage and respond to events more effectively. With this feature, you can now view resource tags directly within Health events for supported AWS services. This allows you to quickly identify which resources are affected and understand their business context without needing to navigate to individual service consoles. changes.title: AWS AppConfig launches support for managing native AI model and AI prompt configuration
changes.detail: Today, AWS AppConfig introduces two new configuration profile types to help you manage the settings for your generative AI applications: AI model invocation configurations, and AI prompt configurations. You can now change model settings and prompts while your application is running, without redeploying code. These updates use AWS AppConfig's safe deployment practices, including gradual rollouts and automatic rollback.
